reviews.text: Doctor Murphy has been wonderful for all my Cavalier King Charles. He cares and loves our boys just as his own. Technician and office staff are kind and friendly, I mean everyone we met through 19 years experience with CityVet uptown.

Thank you, Cassy, for the recommendation! ❤️ Jackie, Dave, and Dr. Duran took such great care of our kitty, Eeve. We truly appreciate the love and care they showed her. We’ll definitely see you all again soon! 🐾💕

The entire team at CityVet is amazing. My dog/cat and I are always greeted with a smile, questions and concerns are always answered and more. I highly recommend you bring your animals to city vet for the best care!

I had a great experience at CityVet Uptown! Everyone was so nice, friendly, and welcoming. The staff was helpful and made the whole experience feel comfortable and easy. You can really tell they care about their clients and their pets. Highly recommend CityVet Uptown!

I had scheduled an appointment for my dog’s sedated nail trimming and was told I’d receive instructions for what to do before the appointment but I received zero information. I cancelled the appointment because I found this unprofessional and concerned for my dog’s health because what if I did something wrong before dropping him off.

Awful experience, would NOT recommend to anyone. My boyfriend and I brought our two cats here and they were both diagnosed with ringworm. The clinic only had one bottle of medicine for my kitten, and told us they would call in a prescription for my adult cat and let us know when the medicine was ready. First, nobody notified us when the medication was ready for pickup. I only found out after reaching out to them multiple times. Second, nobody communicated that my adult cat would run out of medicine and need a refill halfway through his scheduled regimen. I had to call them to request a refill for him. When I came to the clinic to pick up the refill (which, once again, they failed to notify me was ready for pickup), they charged me full price for the whole bottle despite the fact that my cat will not need the whole bottle to complete his regimen. Mind you, we already paid $120 for the first bottle and they wanted to charge us $120 again. When I asked why no one communicated to us that we would even need a 2nd bottle or give us a heads up that we would have to pay for another one, they didn’t have an answer. When I asked if they could only give me the amount he needs and charge me for that, they said no. When I asked if they could give me a discount for how grossly mishandled this whole situation has been, they also said no! So thank you so much CityVet Uptown for your negligence and lack of proper communication about what I would say are pretty important medications for my cats. I will not be bringing them back!
We brought our kitty in with an emergency.  Dr. Duran and staff took quick action to assess her condition and directed us to the best care possible.  We will choose them again!!
Great staff and groomer

I have had my pups here at City Vet Uptown for a couple years now and I am very pleased. Dr. Rech takes good care of the pups and is very thorough in explaining everything. I have unfortunately had to put a dog down here at this office and while it was the worst day of my life, they made it as comfortable and easy as possible. I highly recommend this City Vet location and Dr. Rech.
Thank you for your 5-star review! -CityVet Uptown

I love CityVet Uptown! I’ve been taking my dog Joey there since we moved to Dallas in 2022. Now my dog Chandler also goes there. The girls love going to day play. They also get groomed at Ruffit and they always do a great job. The doctors and staff are so caring and attentive. Dr. Rech has been seeing the girls recently and he has been great to deal with. He was happy to answer all my questions and concerns.
The prompt response to my concern for my Cavachon and their willingness to see her quickly and diagnose with medication set my heart at ease. Dr Murphy and his whole staff are just excellent!
They are the best and most friendly staff!

The entire team at the City Vet are the best !!!they are friendly from beginning to end.the most important thing, they take care my Feathered babies  with kindness and love. This is the only City Vet that I found that treats exotic animals and birds 🤗and I love it. Thanks everyone may God bless you all ❤️
Benson had a great first visit, staff and Dr.  Catherine DiNicola were super nice and knowledgeable!

I love this vet!!! I’ve been a customer for years and the staff always takes great care of my dog!! Dr. Murphy has the best bedside manner and is so knowledgeable about all things!

And Ray is THE BEST! He’s very calm and caring and super friendly. I always feel safe knowing he’s there looking after my puppy!
Great service. I was in and out fairly quickly and the staff were very kind.  The doctor was very thorough and explained the entire process.

I’ve been using City Vet for several years now.  The doctors I’ve seen there (Dr. Duran and Dr. Rech) treat my two cats as real patients and are extremely knowledgeable. In addition, they are very thorough in explaining things to me about their health. The staff is also very helpful and wonderful to work with.
Heather is the BEST groomer at Cityvet/Ruffit Uptown! Been sending my dog to her for 6 years and she always looks precious. The entire team is delightful at this location and so helpful.

Can’t say enough great things about CityVet Uptown. This was our vet when we lived in the area. My dog and I loved coming here, and I knew my pup was getting the best care from the team. To this day, I continue to get compliments on my dog’s excellent health and general appearance of my almost 12 year old baby, and I am certain that the care he received from the staff at CityVet Uptown in the first 8 years of his life played a big role.

Sadly, we moved out of state a few years ago. However, I still recommend this location to friends and family in the Dallas area.

Dr. Murphy is amazing!!! Super smart, empathetic, accessible after hours, and truly cares about your pet as if it were his own. My dog loved him and he is still considered our favorite vet.

The staff here is so friendly, and always take great care of my two cats when I bring them to board when I go out of town. They also make sure to go ahead and give them any necessary services they need with my approval! My cats feel  so comfortable here , and I love that they send me pictures of them.

This place says they require medical exam for giving rabies shot but in Texas there is no such a legal state or city requirement. Ive been bringing my dogs here for a while but this is my last time because this place will MAKE SURE they charge you any possible extra fees that has no basis. Greedy place.

My review is long overdue. I’ve been a City Vet client for over 10 years, and I cannot say enough wonderful things about CityVet Uptown Dallas, especially Cassy and Dr. Coville. Throughout this time Cassy has been one of the main reasons I continue to trust CityVet with my dogs' care.
Cassy is truly the heart of the practice. Her compassion for animals is genuine and unmistakable. She doesn't just know the pets who come through the clinic—she remembers them, follows up on them, and sincerely cares about their health and happiness.
Years ago, Cassy helped me navigate treatment options for my sweet boy, Foster's hip dysplasia including laser therapy that significantly improved his comfort and mobility. She was always patient, encouraging, and willing to answer questions. Her knowledge and dedication made a difficult situation much easier to manage.
Today, Cassy continues to provide that same exceptional level of care for my puppy, Hudson. Whether it's helping coordinate appointments, answering concerns, or simply checking on how he is doing.
I am also deeply grateful to Cassy and Dr. Coville for helping me manage Hudson's sensitive stomach and Shar-Pei Fever. Anyone dealing with a chronic condition in their pet knows how stressful and emotional it can be. Dr.Coville’s thoroughness is unmatched and Hudson absolutely adores her. He loves going to City Vet.
In a world where exceptional customer service is becoming harder to find, Cassy and Dr.Coville are truly one of a kind. Their dedication, kindness, empathy, and love for animals set the standard for what veterinary care should be.
After more than a decade of knowing Cassy, I can honestly say she has made a meaningful difference in the lives of both Foster and Hudson, and in mine as well.
CityVet Uptown Dallas is fortunate to have someone as remarkable as Cassy leading the office, and I wholeheartedly recommend this practice to anyone looking for veterinary care from people who treat your pets like family.

Have been boarding my dogs here and they’ve been patients of Dr. Murphy for years.

I will not be coming back for any service or boarding again after dealing with the manager personally.

I’ve been aware my dog’s teeth were in bad condition and likely needed extractions/intense dental care. I’d been quoted over the phone “600  dollars or so” before the procedure itself. I brought my dog the day of and was given a quote of 800-2200 dollars, with 2200 including full treatment (but included about 10 line items the receptionist told me were optional and an annual + vaccines that totaled about 1000 which she said she’d take off).

I STUPIDLY signed the edited estimate instead of having her draft an entirely new one because I trusted this office at their word. I also had previously checked not to be contacted if emergent circumstances arise, an option I selected when they were being boarded, not for medical procedures. Anyways, they called me and told me partial information about what was going on with my dog, so I was unprepared and completely taken aback when my total in the end was 1900.

Do not trust this office to be transparent.
Do not trust this office to provide solutions.

When I asked what would happen because I literally couldn’t afford to give them 1900 dollars that day, the manager said they would turn me into collections and never be welcomed back.

Thank god for Dave saving the day, because HE allowed me to pay partially and pay the rest in the coming days when I would be able to actually pay the balance. I would not be shocked if the power tripping insensitive and rude manager still turned me into collections.

I’ll be taking all future business to a reputable and honest establishment from here on out. Don’t sign ANYTHING until you’ve fine tooth combed each document they give you and avoid dealing with the manager who is downright a mean person.

Update:

Even if every dollar of the final bill is defensible, you allowed a long-term client to leave confused and blindsided instead of taking the time to explain how the final total was calculated.

Your response focuses on the estimate being emailed and signed, but it ignores the core issue: the final bill was not broken down or explained to me when I expressed confusion. The estimate I signed contained handwritten changes and crossed-out line items, which led me to believe the pricing had been adjusted accordingly. That misunderstanding was never clarified.

Your office manager herself acknowledged that additional treatment was performed without obtaining updated authorization because I had previously signed consent allowing the office to proceed with emergent care. That may have protected the office procedurally, but it did nothing to help me understand how the final total was reached.

I accept responsibility for not scrutinizing every page of the paperwork. What I do not accept is being treated as though confusion over a nearly $1,900 bill was unreasonable. When I expressed concern about the cost, I was not walked through the charges. I was told I would be sent to collections and would not be welcome back if I could not pay.

After years of bringing my pets to this practice, I did not expect the relationship to end with threats and me in tears. What is most disappointing is that rather than acknowledging how this interaction was handled with me directly, the response continues to dispute my experience.

Dr. Murphy was not present for that conversation, yet the office continues to characterize it differently than the people who were actually there experienced it.

Dr. Murphy and his entire team are a 10/10! They always go above and beyond for their patients and clients! If you're seeking exceptional medical care and a team that treats your pets like their own, this is the place to bring your fur babies 💯💯.

Love this doc and staff!  Up front pricing and estimates and very clear about what treatments are needed for my pets.  Doc goes above and beyond and cares about his patients.  Practice manager is sweet and takes care to listen to concerns and address complaints: seemed really patient with a lady that was having a hard time in the lobby when I was there.

10/10 absolutely trust this team with my dogs.

These guys are the best. Dr. Ross in particular. They are compassionate and caring to my dogs and very considerate of my pocket book!! I have 3 dogs , currently dr. Civil me is my doctor and she puts her experience and heart I to my dogs. Recently she helped Rocky, my 12 lb Morkie. I can’t say enough about her

I have never had a bad experience with CityVet Uptown. The staff are always pleasant, and Blu never seems scared when I drop him off or pick him up. The veterinary team has worked with Blu for the past four years as we’ve navigated his allergies here in Texas, and they’ve always made us feel cared for throughout the process. Their pricing does seem a bit higher in comparison to some other local vets, but the overall experience and level of care have never made me question staying a customer.
Thank you for your 5-star review! -CityVet Uptown

Our little Oliver has been seeing Dr. Murphy and his team for 9 years - from his time as a young dog until his last breath this past weekend. We wanted to thank the staff for taking care of our little guy over the years and fitting him into a busy schedule when he became very sick.
Great communication. I was in and out quick.  Plenty parking.   Great attitude
The staff is always kind and great at what they do.
Thank you for your 5-star review!
Thank you for your 5-star review! We appreciate you!
Thanks for your feedback Anna!

I can’t say enough amazing things about CityVet Uptown. From the moment you walk in, you can feel that this place is different in the best way possible.

Dr. Coville is truly exceptional. You can tell immediately that she’s not just incredibly knowledgeable, but that she genuinely cares. She takes the time to explain everything, answers every question without rushing, and treats your pet like they’re her own. That level of compassion and attentiveness is rare, and it makes such a difference.

And Dave at reception? He is a gem! He is professional, personable, and remarkably attentive.

Thank you Uptown City Vet!
Dr Murphy and the staff were wonderful for my rabbit. I would highly recommend

Recently had my fur baby euthanized at this location.  The staff did not seem very sympathetic during or after this painful experience.  One of the other City Vet locations light a candle in the front office area to allow customers to know what others are currently going through.  This location did not. No one offered my family any private place to gather our emotions, and not certain if they even said anything as we left during such a traumatic time.  We have yet to receive a call or card just to follow-up as an act of kindness, which should be standard for customers who deal with this process of making a very emotional decision to euthanize their beloved pet.

Updated 3/23/26
I truly don’t know what I would have done without Dr. Murphy, Dr. Coville, and the entire CityVet team. They have incredibly difficult jobs, but they show up every day with not only professionalism, but genuine compassion and care that goes far beyond what you would expect.

They treat your pet like it’s their own. They laugh with you, take photos with you and your “kids,” and when things take a turn for the worse, they sit with you, cry with you, and support you through some of the hardest moments. They don’t just care for the animals—they care deeply for the people who love them.

They cared for both my dog and my cat for years, and over the past four months, they helped me through the heartbreaking experience of saying goodbye to both of them. I have had pets my entire life and have worked with many vets in different places I’ve lived—but never once has leaving a vet impacted me like this. I cried knowing they would no longer be part of my pets’ lives or mine.

Dr. Murphy has always been incredibly attentive, kind, and responsive—going out of his way to follow up with calls or even texts when I couldn’t answer. Dr. Coville and the entire staff are just as amazing—kind, patient, and always willing to go above and beyond.

CityVet also makes everything seamless, from grooming to checkups to boarding, all in one place—but what truly sets them apart is the heart behind everything they do.

If I ever find myself ready to have a pet again one day, there is no question I would return to CityVet Uptown.

Thank you for taking such incredible care of my fur babies—and for the laughs, the hugs, the tears, and the unwavering support. It meant more than I can ever put into words.

I like it
Phone guidance
Reasonable price
Easy to make appointment
Friendly and timely support
Clear communication

End

Dr. Murphy and his staff are the best.
They are friendly and very knowledgeable!!
Simply Great !!!
Just love this place and the NEW Dr. Reck, is AWESOME! HOPE THEY KEEP HIM.

Always love CityVet! The vet staff is super attentive, kind and always helpful. Everyone there treats my dog cowboy like a king and he LOVES going to the vet. Couldn’t recommend them more! Dr. Coville is our absolute favorite!!!
Great experience for all of my cats! I’ve been coming here for 5+ years.
Thanks for your feedback.- CityVet Uptown
Thank you for your 5-star review, Jules! -CityVet Uptown

Absolutely terrible experience. They did not walk us through pricing upfront and pushed unnecessary shots and exams that we explicitly said we did not want. The entire visit was recorded and later used to claim that pricing was disclosed, but only the list of shots was mentioned not the actual costs. At no point were we told what anything would cost before the exams and add-ons were performed.This felt misleading and calculated rather than transparent. If you don’t clearly ask for written pricing upfront, expect surprises. This will be the last time I use this company.

My dog Peanut has been going to this cityvet for more than 12 years now.  Dr. Murphy is beyond awesome.  He's a straight shooter, and will give you the info you need to not only understand the issue, but also to understand why he's suggesting the course of action.  The great thing about this cityvet location is that you get the whole team.  All the vets seem to bounce each of the cases off of each other thus your getting some additional input from other professionals.

The Vet Techs are also great and very "mature" in their role at this cityvet.  The listen to you thoroughly and with compassion.

The front staff is awesome too.  I was lucky as I got to deal with Shelby for the longest time, but the newer girls are just as good.

The best.
Excellent care for our little dog friend!

City Vet | Uptown has very good  Dr's when it comes to your pet. They explain to you what they need to do and are very caring.  All the Dr's  from City Vet are so amazing.  I'm very satisfied with them. I give them 1000 % stars. My is 7 bunnies that I have only  part of them have been seen by the City Vet. But if they get sick I will take them the City Vet.

I’ve called as soon as they opened on two different occasions to see if I could drop off my sick pets and they were able to get me in. I’m so grateful for Cityvet Uptown’s staff for taking great care of my babies!

Such caring people!  Opie was cared for sweetly and kindly. If I ever had a thought of going to another vet it’s gone now!  Thanks to the staff and to Dr Coville for the wonderful care we received at City Vet Uptown!
Experienced,  kind persons and vets.

I liked a lot the way that they welcomed the patients.
They are  all, very nice people.❤️

I’m pet sitting my absolute favorite pup, and he got really sick while I was watching him. The staff were amazing. they were able to work him in two days in a row since his kennel cough got really bad quick and made everything as easy as possible for me, even with the owner out of town. It was super stressful, but their care and flexibility made it so much easier!

Dr Duran was great with my Ellie Mae.  This was an initial visit since moving to Dallas and really liked her process and handling of my old girl.
Have to check back in 2 weeks and all seems good.

Good to have the comfort of a good vet here in Dallas.
Very attentive staff! Helpful in treating dog allergies…

Just had our Schnauzer groomed at City Vet on McKinney & as always totally pleased with the cut.    Heather is the best in town & believe me I have tried many.  Bella is our second Schnauzer & they require monthly grooming to look great.
Thanks again Heather for a well done grooming!!
Me and my fur baby love CityVet uptown and their staff! The are always so attentive and loving towards all dogs there. My dog always has a blast when she is there!
Team at citivet does a great job with my 2 puppies. My only issue, we moved to Rockwall and the citivet here is not open yet!

Brought my dog Montie in after some bug bites got infected, and the team here was wonderful. Everyone was so kind and gentle with him, and they made the whole visit easy. Really appreciate how sweet they were to Montie. Five stars!

We love CityVet Uptown! The staff is so friendly and my dogs absolutely love going to boarding. It makes me feel so happy knowing they are being taken care of by a staff that really cares about them. The Doctors are all so wonderful and helpful.
Convenient and kind service as always. We trust our dogs’ care to CityVet Uptown.

I cannot express how lucky I am to have found CityVet Uptown. Specifically the Vet, Dr. Coville, and Client Service Specialist Shay R. I cannot recommend them enough. I brought in a sick kitten I rescued, my first pet ever, we made several visits and each one of them was a breeze.

Dr. Coville was so informative and kind, she explained step by step, gave multiple options for care, and diagnosed and cured my sweet kitten! I took her back to get spayed and Dr. Coville was so communicative. She performed an amazing surgery and made sure my kitten was comfortable and in no pain.

Shay R is a true gem. She watched over my kitten before and after surgery and gave her SO much love and care. I was so anxious for surgery time with this being my first pet, as soon as I spoke with Shay R, I felt at ease. Shay played with my kitten, gave her favorite food, let me visit with her, and even sent me a few pictures while she was staying overnight! I don’t think my kitten wanted to leave, she was getting so much love and attention from everyone!

My pup and I both LOVE CityVet! The vet techs are amazing and so friendly. I can tell the vets (my pup sees Dr Murphy and Dr Coville) truly love the animals in their care.
My dog goes to doggy day play several days a week and I can tell he has the best time - he’s always so happy when we pull up. He loves going to the vet!

I discovered cityVet Uptown when I got my dog Django 4 years ago. They were referred to me by someone and I have been with them ever since. Convenient location, friendly/helpful folks up front, knowledgeable/caring/efficient medical staff and the doctors are the best.

I love Dr. Murohy he is truly the kindest and most considerate doctor I have met. He has so much knowledge and experience. I love his staff especially Ray. I’m grateful and appreciate  all of them for taking care of Arya.
The vet and nurses did a phenomenal job taking care of my bunny! They handled him with care, explained everything really well, and where very friendly. So grateful for them!
They always took the best possible care of my pet and staff was always very friendly and responsive.

I can’t praise CityVet - Uptown enough. The staff is attentive, patient, knowledgeable, and supporting. Dr Coville, Shae, Francesca and everyone I have interacted with have been truly wonderful. I am a very anxious girly and being able to go directly to an exam room when you enter for the appointment is a plus for me. They take great care of my boy during each of our visits making sure he is comfortable. Dr Coville is always so patient with me answering all of my questions especially when it came to his surgery. It shows how much they care because Dr Coville and other team members called me after his surgery to follow up and see how he was doing. I have never trusted a vet clinic as much as this one.

I love this place, the people is the best of the best and my pet is very happy with this service!!!
Five stars ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️🐕 …

My poor dog ate a bunch of stuff he wasn’t supposed to, completely my wife’s fault, and got very sick. They saw him immediately and made him all better. He is a special needs dog and they treat him with the best care so much that he almost doesn’t hate going to the vet.

Dr. Coville is AMAZING and the techs @ CityVet Uptown are wonderful!  I’ve been taking my dog there since adoption but 5 mos. ago we discovered she had 5 mast cell tumors and 1 melanoma that required treatment w/ some needing multiple passes to ensure clear margins.  In addition to that, after the final surgery my dog had contracted MRSP (essentially doggy MRSA) and we were having trouble getting her final wound to heal.

Throughout the entire process Dr. Coville was dedicated to ensure that Sasha received the best treatment possible.  Dr. Coville was diligent in her communications, follow-ups, presenting all available options, and even worked to minimize the cost of treatment for us every step of the way where possible being cognizant of my current situation.

I’m happy to say that all treatment was successful and I have a healthy happy baby ready to take on the world again thanks to Dr. Coville and the entire staff (it was a team effort!).  Even if the outcome wasn’t ideal it wouldn’t have been due to the efforts provided by CityVet Uptown.  Class operation.  I’d give 7 stars if I could.  Thank you all!
Everyone was so friendly. They took great care of my cat. My cat had knee surgery and Dr Murphy was amazing.

I've never had a vet who actually cares about my dog's health as much Dr. Murphy. My dog loves him, any issues he has are actually treated (no unnecessary $500+ repeat visits bc the problem wasn't actually fixed), and also reasonably priced. Can't recommend Dr. Murphy and CityVet Uptown enough!

They take such good care of my sweet boy!
All smiles!

I had a fantastic first experience at CityVet Uptown, the staff were incredibly friendly and knowledgeable. They made our entire visit so easy, and I get the peace of mind that comes with knowing my dogs vaccinations are fully up to date.

Would highly recommend. Out of so many choices in Dallas, I didn’t know where to go! the QUALITY of care was outstanding! Sha, Nevaeh, and Dr. Cordell were awesome. The entire team was, in fact! From the time I called to set an appointment (that I got fit into within 30 min, thanks to Sha) … to the time we walked in the front door… our experience was delightful. Smiles on everyone’s faces and all the pets were happy and relaxed. Thank you! And God Bless!

Best place EVER for your pet.  Front desk personnel are awesome, and very  patient. Vet techs, can’t beat ‘em.  They take time to listen. (You know how all pet parents like to tell our stories.) Regardless, of what doctor you get there…, You are in great hands from beginning to end.
Always gives my dog great care, Dr. Coville is very kind and knowledgeable. Been coming here for several years. Thank you for everything 🙏 …
Just went to pick up a pet for a friend
Dr Murphy is great!
I have a 17-year old dachsund who requires a little more special care. CityVet Uptown is always so kind and patient with him for vet care and boarding.

Update- 7 years here and at other CityVet’s locations. Bingo and Ranger love it and so do we!

We've seen Dr. Weganast since we got Bingo about 5 months ago.  This practice is extremely helpful, prompt to schedule appointments, and care about your pet. Strongly recommend their Puppy Plan when getting your first puppy.  Have also used their "Ruff It" for daycare and Bingo came back exhausted, as we wanted!

Shay at the McKinney Ave location is AMAZING!  Been to a few other locations (oak lawn and Preston/Forest) and meh.
But the staff at the McKinney location is fantastic! Every time I leave, I’m grateful for the care they’ve taken of my baby girl.
I have been using CityVet Uptown for all of Annabelle's vet needs since I got her. Dr. Matt Murphy is fantastic. This is an update: CityVet Uptown and Dr. Murphy are still the gold standard.

Dr. Murphy, Dr. Ross, and the whole CityVet/RuffIt Uptown crew are phenomenal! My little guy Zeus is quite the rough housing Aussie, but they take such great care of him no matter what we’re in for (grooming, vet, boarding, etc.). Love working with such a great group of folks!

They are so good with our dogs, we always appreciate their kind and attentive care! The techs were wonderful, vet answered all my questions.  Overall the appointment for two dogs took about 35 minutes, we were in and out.

I particularly love that they have you pay in the private room, it removes a step when the dogs are wound up and prevents any mishaps in the lobby area. Great attention to detail and thoughtfulness.

Losing a fur baby is never easy, but I really sincerely would like to thank Dr. Murphy and his amazing team. They made probably one of the hardest things I've had to do in my life just a little bit easier. I really appreciate their empathy and how they explained their process when we went in.

Cityvet/ Ruff It Uptown is this magical place where they somehow do it all SO well and with a smile! Day play, overnight care, vet visits and grooming all in one spot. The facilities are clean and my dog Butter always comes home feeling so happy and tired. We also had a crazy hot spot on my dog and they took such great care of him so fast and kept me in the loop on the procedure every step of the way. The service in general is also top notch- they are super responsive via call, text, email, in person and SO stinkin’ kind- shout out to all my front desk girlies for always easing the mind of this crazy dog mom! Butter and I love and appreciate you for taking such great care of him all the time 🫶🫶🫶🫶🫶🫶🫶
